data.narrative: The learner demonstrated exceptional command of CI/CD engineering by constructing an automated GitHub Actions pipeline with fail-fast quality gates, dependency caching, git SHA image tagging, and image size guardrails (<200MB). They systematically identified and resolved secret leakage risks and enforced strict main-branch deployment policies.

dimension_scores.observation: Integrated container build directly into pipeline with automated size verification (<200MB) and smoke tests.
dimension_scores.evidence: Added docker image inspect size validation step in .github/workflows/ci.yml.

dimension_scores.observation: Engineered sequential fail-fast pipeline gating heavy builds on successful lint and test completion.
dimension_scores.evidence: Configured Lint -> Test -> Compile -> Docker Build -> Size Check -> Publish in .github/workflows/ci.yml.

dimension_scores.observation: Added runtime smoke test verifying container /live endpoint and structured step output.
dimension_scores.evidence: Verified curl --fail http://localhost:3000/live smoke test step in workflow.

dimension_scores.observation: Analyzed and remediated tri-symptom breakdown covering secret leakage, cache poisoning, and unintended branch deploys.
dimension_scores.evidence: Detailed root causes and mitigations in progress/production/module-02-break.md.

dimension_scores.observation: Implemented job timeout safeguards (15m) to prevent stuck runners from exhausting compute quotas.
Documented full trigger matrix, secret handling policies, and failure-first drill mechanisms.
dimension_scores.evidence: Captured complete verification matrix in progress/production/module-02-verify.md and module-02-fix.md.

strengths: Applied fail-fast pipeline design principles to catch errors in the cheapest, earliest stages.
Prevented secret leakage by utilizing official GitHub Actions authentication actions and scoped tokens.
data.recommendation: Advance to Module 03 to configure environment-specific runtime configurations and secrets management across environments.

public_evidence.student_action: Authored complete production CI/CD workflow with linting, unit testing, git SHA containerization, and image size guardrails.
public_evidence.technical_detail: GitHub Actions workflow with npm cache, 15m timeout, size check <200MB, and ghcr.io publishing.
public_evidence.ability: Designing and hardening automated CI/CD deployment pipelines with zero secret leakage and fail-fast quality gates.
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Eliminates deployment drift, automates quality enforcement, and protects production registries from unvetted code.

concepts_demonstrated.evidence: Configured automated triggers on push/pull_request to main.
Separated lint, test, build, and publish into distinct sequential steps.

teaching_approaches.detail: End-to-end implementation of pipeline with failure-first drills and secret masking validation.

learning_style_signals: Demonstrates exceptional proficiency with automated workflows, declarative YAML configurations, and test gating.
